NEW EVENTS — ARMOR, WEAPONS AND HEIRLOOMS, ARM-46 to ARM-95 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing "Isola — Armor, Weapons, and Inherited Traditions" (events 01-45, shipped as ARMOR-01..45). Same style as yours: "NN. Title — one or two sentences", numbered 46-95.

collection.description: An artisan restoring an old shield leaves one deep, old gash unmended because it is part of the shield's history.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: (Name1), an artisan restoring an old shield, leaves one deep, old gash unmended because it is part of the shield's history. The family is divided about it, and for now the gash stays.
